content.text: The licence provisions meet the preferred position on every material term.

input.quote: 13.1 Subject to payment of applicable Fees, Vendor grants Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf a worldwide, non-exclusive right during the subscription term to access and use the hosted Services and documentation for their internal business purposes and to provide services to Customer.
input.rationale:
Section 13 satisfies the preferred position in full. 13.1 extends the subscription grant to our Affiliates and to contractors acting on their behalf (with Authorized User rights), without any "revocable" or "non-transferable" language. 13.2 gives a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free, fully paid licence to Customer and its Affiliates for paid-up software and embedded Vendor Technology, including contractor support rights, and 14.3 confirms that licence covers Vendor Technology needed to use a Deliverable. 13.3 permits transfer to an Affiliate or successor under the Section 24 assignment right (24.1 allows M&A assignment without consent; 24.4 bars Vendor termination/suspension on our change of control) and limits revocation or suspension to a material uncured payment or use breach after notice and a reasonable cure opportunity — so the licence is not revocable at will. 13.4's use restrictions are ordinary (reverse engineering, interference, security bypass, unlawful use), are qualified by "knowingly" and by Applicable Law, and expressly do not limit authorized security testing or our use of Customer Data and output; they do not undermine the grant. No redline needed.</parationale>
